title: Warm Smoky Venezuelan Cream Cheese Empanadas
description: Smoky and pillowy empanadas filled with cream cheese, perfect for a quick snack or dessert. This recipe features a smoky deglaze and is gluten-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the cream cheese, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and salt until well combined.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the cream cheese mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the empanadas until browned on the bottom.
Transfer the empanadas to a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the empanadas are baking, deglaze the skillet with a tablespoon of water, scraping up any browned bits.
Serve the empanadas warm, garnished with the smoky deglaze.
